summary: Prisoma: a world-model and PID research platform with exact candidate identities, observers for native and modular NCP capture, and an application bridge. AGENTS.md is the operating contract; this index restates its operational facts for tools.

entry_documents.role: PID method, route and publication contract

delivery.merge: Commit the source change in a separate worktree from origin/main, refresh the candidate identities in a second commit, run the applicable gates, then push to main.
delivery.attribution: no AI attribution or co-author trailers

gates.when: agent-index.json or a path it names changes
a capability catalog or the application bridge changes
after the source commit and the candidate refresh commit

generated.regenerate: commit the source change, run uv run --no-sync python scripts/generate_candidate_release.py --print-source-state, pass the printed arguments to the same generator and commit its output separately

frozen.reason: submodule gitlink that pins PID; change it only through an explicit adoption

shared.reason: legacy Host API 1.1 descriptor with its lock; Paper2Brain holds the same bytes and check-contract.py pins their digests
